title: Plant Manager
text:
Location:
 
DCO Operations

Address:
 
Atlantic City, NJ

Organization:
 
DCO Energy, LLC

Job Type:
 
Full-Time

Posting Date:
 
11/13/2026

SUMMARY
 

* Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, the Plant Manager is responsible for providing management direction and leadership to ensure that the energy facility is operated in a safe, reliable, and economic manner consistent with site contracts, permits, and rules and regulations.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
 

* Operates the facility in a safe manner and ensures that a safe work environment is provided to minimize the risk of accidents and injuries.
* Compliance with all company policies, procedures, and commercial commitments
* Implement programs and activities that provide a work environment that promotes effective goal accomplishment, productivity, and morale
* Optimize plant performance through appropriate utilization manpower, equipment, supplies and external support.
* Provide coaching, training, and development opportunities for the team to ensure appropriate skill sets are maintained
* Establish procedures and controls to manage all expense activities to conform to established budgets
* Communicate effectively with the site staff, management, customers, vendors, and outside agencies
* Demonstrate effective management skills in meeting or exceeding facility goals and objectives

 
QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

* A four-year degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or commensurate experience is required as well demonstrated track record of successful goal achievement
* A minimum of ten (10) to fifteen (15) year’s relevant experience, with a minimum of ten years in a management position.
* A through, demonstrated knowledge of energy facility operations and maintenance as well as management methods necessary to control and improve facility performance.
* Experience managing and supervising employees operating Gas Turbine, Plant Auxiliary Equipment, and Emergency Generators.
* Experience in tracking and reporting Individuals for this position must have good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 50 pounds), walking, and stooping.
* Ability to manage a schedule in a timely and accurate manner
* Ability to handle other administrative duties as assigned by management
* Moderate to advanced MS Outlook Excel, Powerpoint, and Word

 
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS
 

* GOLD STEAM AND RED REFRIGERATION
* NJ STEAM AND CHILLED WATER LICENSES

 
JOB REQUIREMENTS
 
 
Demonstrated knowledge of all facets of power plant operations. Demonstrated ability to make competent decisions in emergency situations, writing operating procedures and training of other personnel. Demonstrate good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 75 pounds), walking, and stooping.

Salary Range: 140K-175K annually
